newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank says sets next two repos at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank says sets next two repos at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday that it would set its next two securities repurchase tenders at a fixed rate of three percent.
The Bundesbank has kept the repo, its main money market rate, fixed at three percent since August and money market dealers had not expected a change in the rate at the meeting.
The Bundesbank council met a day earlier than usual due to Thursday's regional holiday in Germany.
